content:
**Design doc**: .design/mod-policy-workbook.md
**Implements**: REQ-E1, REQ-E2; AC-6

**Files to add**:
- deploy/seeds/mod-policies.yml (5 placeholders incl. polaris.csam with human_required_always=TRUE)
- polaris-backend/src/seed/mod_policies.rs

**Files to modify**:
- polaris-backend/src/main.rs — after migrations + setup, invoke the seed loader if mod_policies is empty AND a bootstrap admin exists

**Rust quality**:
- serde_yaml deserialise into strongly-typed SeedPolicy (no JSON-Value smuggling)
- Idempotency: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mod_policies) before any insert; loaded rows attribute created_by_moderator_id = bootstrap admin (same query polaris-setup uses)
- POLARIS_POLICY_SEED_PATH env var overrides /etc/polaris/seeds/mod-policies.yml

**Tests**:
- tests/policy_seed_idempotent.rs — first boot loads 5 rows; second boot no-op; corrupted seed file never clobbers existing rows

**Blocked by**: #223
